verifiedClaimSummary: Musculoskeletal structure/function, limbs/back/joints and peripheral nerves, linked to disease, clinical reasoning, history-taking and back examination. Functional Anatomy shares the anatomical structure-function subject, while VU clinical practice is additional.

Inflammatory disease, infectious and autoimmune mechanisms, dermatology/rheumatology, common and tropical infections, antimicrobial treatment and resistance. Infection & Immunity shares central immune/host-pathogen mechanisms; clinical disease management remains additional.

Cardiovascular pathophysiology and treatment across blood-pressure regulation, coronary disease, failure, vascular disease, haemostasis and fluid balance; patient cases and clinical inquiry/communication. Mechanisms of Disease shares the cardiovascular mechanism strand within its broader six-system survey.

Homeostasis through autonomic/endocrine systems, temperature regulation, shock, receptors, pharmacology, hormone systems and insulin/glucose regulation, with clinical applications. Human Physiology shares regulation/homeostasis, without the full medical framing.

Respiratory and digestive structure/function, nutrient metabolism and regulation, liver/pancreas, microbiome and clinical examples/examination. Biochemistry directly shares an important nutrient-metabolism strand; respiratory/digestive clinical content remains additional.

Cell/tissue injury, inflammation, repair, adaptive immunity and immunological dysfunction, linked to clinical disease. Molecular Pathology & Genetics shares the central injury/repair/inflammatory subjects and adds genetics.

Three principal themes: lifestyle and motivation; population prevention/screening and health inequalities; healthcare organization/financing, with clinical professional examples. Medical & Health Psychology shares lifestyle/illness behavior, while care-system and population-medical breadth remains additional.

Clinical genetics plus medical/epidemiological study designs, research questions, data/statistical analysis and a group research/poster project. Research Methods & Statistics shares design/analysis/project methods; clinical genetics is not reproduced.

Local primary and community care in Amsterdam, global determinants, gender/diversity and intersectionality, social structures and inequalities, health advocacy, and community service-learning/participatory projects. Supports the second programme's population-health/social-inclusion concept; general UCR sociology/rights do not claim clinical preparation.

Human sensory and nervous-system structure/function, pathways, neurological lesions, motor/behavioral systems, higher functions and sleep/consciousness; hearing/vision examination and patient communication. Brain & Behavior is the stronger human-brain foundation than comparative animal Neurobiology; VU clinical/sensory depth remains explicit.

Psychopathology across the lifespan, classification, neurobiological and cognitive mechanisms, psychiatric treatment including drugs and psychotherapy, patient cases and psychiatric examination. Abnormal Psychology shares the central disorder/classification/treatment subject, without the complete medical practice.

Development from newborn toward adulthood, including physical/organ growth, motor and psychosocial development, prevention, nutrition and pediatric disease. Lifespan Developmental Psychology shares an important developmental strand without reproducing pediatric clinical care.
